verdict.rationale: Crossmint is a payments and agent-checkout platform, so a developer-facing dispute and chargeback API is a fair axis to judge it on. The only dispute-related evidence says that for general card checkout Crossmint itself "will take on the risk and manage disputes directly with the bank." That is an adjacent risk-absorption policy, not an API for submitting evidence, checking dispute status or retrieving outcomes. Nothing in the pack shows any dispute endpoints for agent transactions.
